name: zvid_texture_pack_shutdown_builtin_packs
description: zVid_TexturePack::ShutdownBuiltinPacks shuts down built-in texture-directory runtime files, frees each built-in pack records array, frees the built-in pack table, and clears the global table/count.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target covers 0x46d6b0 yet, so tier S remains open.

The native smoke reaches zVid_TexturePack::ShutdownBuiltinPacks through zImage::ShutdownSubsystem and zVid_TexDir::Shutdown; direct helper coverage is accepted from Binary Ninja evidence plus the caller smoke's built-in pack state assertions.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x46d6b0 calls zImage::ShutdownTextureDirectoryRuntime, walks g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePacks with a 0xa4 byte stride, frees each non-null records pointer at offset 0x9c, clears that records slot, frees the global built-in pack table, clears g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePacks, and clears g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePackCount.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x46d6b0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same built-in pack records loop, global table free, pointer clear, and count clear; the pointer arithmetic is the documented BN limitation from the current function comment.
The dependency frontier for 0x46d6b0 has no visible functional-verification blockers after accepting zImage::ShutdownTextureDirectoryRuntime and the CRT free provider.

The native zimage_shutdown_texdir_smoke allocates one built-in texture pack with records and an open file, reaches this helper through ShutdownSubsystem, and verifies g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePackCount is zero and g_zVid_BuiltinTexturePacks is null after shutdown.
